checkpoints.name: sparse_column_discrepancy_large_k
checkpoints.description: Theorem 1.3 of Bansal-Jiang (STOC 2026, arXiv 2508.03961v2), the k >= log^2 n branch of Theorem 5.1: there exist c, C > 0 such that every {0,+-1} matrix A with at most k non-zero entries per column and k >= c (log n)^2 has a +-1 coloring with ||Ax||_inf <= C sqrt(k); stated for {0,+-1} matrices (stronger than the printed {0,1} form), algorithmic clauses dropped (see tests/reference/concept-ledger.md).
